## grok-BizPilot - BriefPilot Pro
Daily owner command brief built from leads, invoices, reminders, and quotes. Produces max 3 actions, saves to Supabase, sends WhatsApp, and exports to Sheets. Update YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID in the export node and connect credentials before publishing. Fixed: export enabled with Google Sheets credential.
